definitions.explanation: A very large crab (biologically a hermit-crab relative rather than a true crab) prized for its thick, meaty legs. Caught mainly off Hokkaido and in the Bering Sea.

examples.japanese: タラバ{蟹|がに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。

examples.english: King crab has thick meat and is very filling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、タラバ{蟹|がに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: On our trip to Hokkaido, we went to an all-you-can-eat king crab restaurant.

notes:
タラバ{蟹|がに} looks like a crab and is sold as one, but is biologically closer to a hermit crab: it has eight visible legs, not ten, because one pair is small and tucked under the shell.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- タラバ{蟹|がに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{脚|あし}→脚：28733_ashi⟧: king crab legs
- タラバ{蟹|がに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧: one king crab leg

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ズワイ{蟹|がに}→ズワイ蟹：30907_zuwaigani⟧: snow crab — a true crab with ten legs, thinner and less meaty
- タラバ{蟹|がに}: king crab — larger, thicker legs, eight visible legs
